class.name: LLMServer
class.brief_description: Serves an [LLMModel] over HTTP on an OpenAI-compatible surface.
class.description: A [MainLoop], so it runs with no scene: [codeblock lang=text] godot --headless --main-loop LLMServer [/codeblock] Answers [code]GET /health[/code], [code]GET /v1/models[/code], [code]POST /v1/chat/completions[/code] (streaming when the body sets [code]stream[/code]) and [code]POST /rpc[/code]. Configuration is read from the environment at startup: [code]LLM_MODEL[/code] (required), [code]LLM_MMPROJ[/code], [code]LLM_HOST[/code], [code]LLM_PORT[/code], [code]LLM_ALIAS[/code], [code]LLM_CTX[/code], [code]LLM_CTK[/code], [code]LLM_CTV[/code], [code]LLM_NGL[/code] and [code]LLM_THREADS[/code]. It is an event loop rather than a worker thread because [LLMChat] emits its signals through [method Object.call_deferred]: a blocking wait for a completion would deadlock against the main thread that delivers it. [LLMChat] takes one request at a time, so clients queue.
